We have added a new Chronicle! We apologize for the long wait.
We are delighted to have successfully added the new Chronicle with the support of so many people.
We would like to express our gratitude to everyone who provided suggestions and bug fixes on Discord, those who assisted with translations, Yayoi Garuta for creating the beautiful illustrations, and everyone who played Your Chronicle!

To commemorate this major update, we will be holding a “Mimic Harvest Festival” from June 6th for one week!
Details will be announced separately on the announcement page. There will also be a Father's Day reward code in June, so please look forward to that as well!

Although it has been a long time since the last Chronicle was added, we will continue to work hard on development alongside our new development member, Sombra, so please continue to support Your Chronicle!

notes.title: [ ver 2.2.0 ] Major Update!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! Today I am pleased to announce the latest update to Your Chronicle, version 2.2.0.

[b]New Features and Additions[/b].
- [ Add ] New Area
- [ Add ] New Element
- [ Add ] Chinese version
- [ Add ] Auto-summoning/level-up added to offline bonuses
- [ Add ] Automatic save data backup
- [ Modify ] Change the specification of interval multiplier for loop action.
(Even when interval is multiplied, the amount of resources increased/decreased by progress effect/cost will remain constant.)

[b]Thanks for the test version[/b].
Thank you to everyone who played the test version and provided valuable feedback. Thanks to all of you, we can provide a better game experience.

[b]Thanks for translations[/b].
We appreciate the dedication of everyone who helps us with translations on Discord and elsewhere.
We are happy to be able to connect with more players beyond the language barrier.

[b]Mimic Harvest Festival[/b].
I actually forgot about the Mimic Harvest Festival until I wrote this patch note, but now that I'm here, I'm rushing to get to it. Please look forward to it!

I apologize that it has been so long since the last major update.
SamuraiGames will continue to work hard so that everyone can continue to enjoy the game. Thank you for your continued support.

This concludes the announcement of Your Chronicle ver 2.2.0. I hope you enjoy the new features and improvements!

Here it is, v2.1.0 is out!
The main content is a remake of the offline bonuses for dungeons and looping action, but one of the main features is a remake of Sloth.
We hope you all enjoy playing Your Chronicle with all the offline bonuses!
The release of v2.1.0 took longer than expected, but we hope to update more frequently in the future as we did before.
We are currently working on new content, including a new chronicle, so stay tuned for more Your Chronicle!

notes.title: Sloth will be remade at the next patch!
notes.content:
Long time no see, Samurai Games here.
I know it's been a long time between updates, but I'm planning on updating to v2.1.0 next week!
The next update is mainly about the offline bonuses, but one of the changes is that Sloth is being remade at the same time.
Please note that the "settings" of the old Sloth and the new Sloth are not compatible.

The new Sloth works without the shortcut slots and also features offline bonuses.
Please refer to the in-game announcement for more information when the update is available.

Thanks for playing Your Chronicle!

notes.title: [Event] Mimic harvest festival!
notes.content:
In commemoration of Release of "Artwork Addition DLC",
We hold an event : Mimic harvest festival:) (2021, November 1st ~ 15th)

"Artwork Addition" is a DLC that adds an illustration when clearing the story of Your Chronicle.
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1682010/Your_Chronicle__Artwork_Addition/]Your Chronicle - Artwork Addition Link[/url]


During the period,
1) You can enter a special dungeon (where only Mimics spawn) once in a day.
2) The spawn chance of mimic doubles in normal dungeons.

- That dungeon may not appear if you open the game directly on steam version. In that case, it will appear by starting the game from the Steam app.
- Mimic ... A rare monster in this game. He may drop a chest. He usually spawns in normal dungeons except for the boss dungeon in a very low possibility.

notes.title: IEH Collaboration Event
notes.content:
I'm glad that Your Chronicle has been published on steam successfully:)
We hold a simple event with "Incremental Epic Hero (IEH)"! 
It's a Japanese Anime Idle RPG and the developers are my friends!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1530340/Incremental_Epic_Hero/

You can get 5,000 rubies and a silver chest as a reward!
How to get rewards
1. Play IEH once on Steam
2. Press Others>Event button

IEH also holds the same event that you can gain reward in IEH.
(Go to "System" tab > "Bonus Code" and Input "IEHhapiwakuYC")

I'm glad if you join it!
